title: GetGroups scheduler-lock scope out-of-bounds read fix
root_cause: GetGroups read the group count under SCHEDULER_LOCK but released the lock before computing listSize and copying the group list, allowing a concurrent group-list mutation to race the memcpy (published as CVE-2025-20042 out-of-bounds read).
notes: Fix expands the SCHEDULER_LOCK scope so groupCount, listSize and the group-list memcpy stay protected. Historical ground truth for capability evaluation, not a new vulnerability.
